Release diplomas for eligible students from all centres. Eligibility criteria: weekly test average ≥ 60%, Practical marks ≥ 60% (if a Practical test exists for the batch), and final exam score ≥ 60%. Attendance (≥75%) is shown as an advisory indicator but does not block release.

Possible Duplicate Students

Same mobile number or email showing up under more than one Student ID — usually the same person enrolled a second time instead of being added to their existing record. Pick which ID to keep; everything under the other ID(s) gets moved over and the duplicate is removed.

Bulk Offline Upload

Guidelines Upload File Preview & Import
When you create the CSV file for importing offline leads, make sure that the file meets the following formatting requirements:
  1. The files to be imported must be in CSV (comma separated values) format. (Download sample data)
  2. Every column in the CSV file should have a header name. This will help you to identify and map column header names with the existing labels.
  3. The only required field is Email Address (or Mobile Number if Mobile type is selected). All other fields are optional but recommended.
  4. Remove all blank lines from the file to be imported. A blank line is interpreted as the end of the file.
  5. If CSV file contains state/city or any pre-defined list values then these should match with IGI's defined values for successful import.
  6. Optional but important: add Source column in CSV to identify source of lead.
  7. After the import is complete, a summary will be shown with success and failure counts.
  8. The default character for importing multiple entries into a multi-select field is a vertical bar (|). For example: BBA|BCA|BCom.
Supported CSV columns:
First Name, Last Name, Email, Mobile, Alternate Mobile, State, City, Course, Centre, Source, Medium, Campaign, When to Join, Current Profession, Payment Plan, Course Mode, Notes
